name: reach-arm
title: Bracket bench: gauge arm
description: Bolts on top of the rig's wall in place of the lever's gauge arm and reaches out from it over a bracket's tip, holding a dial indicator's 8 mm stem in a clamped bore so its plunger rests on the load bolt's head.
orientation: Flat on the bed, as it sits on the wall. Two M5 × 35 into the wall's slotted nuts; an M4 × 25 across the clamp, its nut in the pocket. Tighten the clamp just enough to hold the stem.

nut4.rule: M4 nut pocket, across the flats

bore.rule: The indicator's stem, a close fit before clamping

beam.rule: The arm's width where it reaches out over the bracket

gauge_x.rule: Over the middle of the load bolt's head, beside the bracket's boss

end.rule: The arm's far end, past the load bolt

slit.rule: The clamp's slit, from the bore to the end

pinch_y.rule: The clamp bolt, across the slit between the bore and the end
